notes: Icy Veins (https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-classic/classic-cooking-profession-guide) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so no Icy Veins comparison was made. The main path is Wowhead's fishing route; Wowhead writes ranges with shared endpoints (1-50, 50-100 ...), recorded here as contiguous (each step starts one above the previous end). Wowhead's guide gives craft counts only for the fish route; every alt has crafts null. Alts come from Wowhead's 'Augmenting Fishing with Meat Recipes' and rogue sections, which give looser ranges than the steps: Charred Wolf Meat and Roasted Boar Meat are 'early' (starting recipes; Wowhead's skill data lists learnedat 0, recorded as learnAt 1); Coyote Steak and Dry Pork Ribs cover 50-130 and their meat drops almost only in Alliance zones; Strider Stew is Wowhead's Horde option for 50-100 (Horde-only recipe item 5486, quest/vendor); Thistle Tea is rogue-only (Recipe: Thistle Tea item 18160 from the level 20 rogue quest Klaven's Tower, quest 2359), usable 60-140; Curiously Tasty Omelet 130-175 (Recipe item 3682, vendor; Alliance: Kendor Kabonka in Stormwind, Horde: Keena in Arathi Highlands or Nerrist in Grom'gol); Roast Raptor 175-225 (Recipe item 12228, same vendors); Rockscale Cod is offered instead of Mithril Headed Trout but turns yellow at 190 vs 215 (Recipe item 6369); Lobster Stew and Baked Salmon (Recipe items 13947, 13949) are sold beside Mightfish Steak in Feralas and use fish from the same areas. The guide's wording for 275-300 says to use Large Raw Mightfish 'or a mix with' Darkclaw Lobster and Raw Whitescale Salmon. Recipe items for the main path: Brilliant Smallfish 6325, Longjaw Mud Snapper 6328, Bristle Whisker Catfish 6330, Mithril Head Trout 17062, Spotted Yellowtail 13939 (Steamwheedle Port, Tanaris), Mightfish Steak 13948 (Vivianna npc 7947, Feathermoon / Sheendra Tallgrass npc 8145, Camp Mojache). Created items, reagents and learnAt come from the recipe list on Wowhead's Cooking skill page. Rank-ups: Journeyman from a trainer before 75 (level 10, skill 50); Expert from Expert Cookbook (item 16072, vendor Shandrina npc 3955 Ashenvale / Wulan npc 12033 Desolace) before 150; Artisan from the quest Clamlette Surprise (quest 6610, breadcrumbs 6611 Horde / 6612 Alliance; needs level 35, skill 225, 12 Giant Egg, 10 Zesty Clam Meat, 20 Alterac Swiss). Wowhead puts the Expert note between 100-150 and 150-175 and splits Bristle Whisker Catfish into 50 + 70 crafts (120 fish total); kept as two steps. Wowhead's fish list: 50 Raw Brilliant Smallfish, 50 Raw Longjaw Mud Snapper, 120 Raw Bristle Whisker Catfish, 60 Raw Mithril Head Trout, 70 Raw Spotted Yellowtail, 25 Large Raw Mightfish.
